set.body: Add direct locus Region, Selection, Parcellation, and Searchlight conversions into mvpa FeatureSet and FeatureSetPlan, plus narrow ordered-selection adapters for multivar IndexSet and RoiPlan. Deprecate the second mvpa-spatial searchlight center and window model while retaining algorithm-level MVPA and multivar plans. Acceptance follows phase 9 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md and focused JVM and Scala.js suites.
set.title: Locus 9: replace duplicate MVPA searchlights and add multivar adapters
